Burger — manual test fixtures

Load the extension unpacked, then open each fixture and verify the expected outcome described in the page.

Positive (should reorder)

  • positive-basic.html — country select, US to top
  • positive-preserves-selection.html — selection preserved
  • positive-dynamic.html — async-inserted country select
  • positive-currency.html — USD to top
  • positive-aria-country.html — ARIA combobox, country
  • positive-aria-currency.html — ARIA combobox, currency
  • positive-shadow-dom.html — <select> inside open shadow DOM

Negative (should NOT reorder)

  • negative-county.html
  • negative-cloud-region.html
  • negative-state.html
  • negative-sensitive-citizenship.html
  • negative-currency-no-usd.html
  • negative-aria-virtualized.html
  • negative-aria-filtered.html
